caption: The Shopify dialog Install app over the Apps page in Settings: the app Attribuly (Attribuly), the text This app needs access to, and three blocks, View customer data (Sensitive data, device and activity data), View staff and contributor data (Store owner) and View and edit store data (Customers, products, orders, discounts, marketing, store analytics, Online Store), the line Why do apps need data access? Check the developer's privacy policy., and the buttons Cancel and Install; behind the dialog is a list of installed apps. The organization name and the store name with their icons in the left menu, and the small store icon in the bottom left corner, are hidden.

The first screen of the app, Choose your ESP, with the text Select the email platform you use. We'll tailor the next steps for your tool. and four cards, Klaviyo (Selected), MambaSMS, Omnisend and CartSee (each with a Select button), a button Start email recovery, the line Not using above ESPs or want to identify anonymous visitors? Book a Demo and the line Only want to use Attribution? Click here to set up. The store name with its small icon in the bottom left corner of the menu is hidden; the chat button at the bottom right is a generic icon.

The onboarding of the app, Find the shoppers Klaviyo can't see, with four steps on the left (1 Connect Klaviyo, 2 Select events, 3 Enable App embed, 4 Activate Klaviyo flow, the first one active) and in the main part the text Connect your Klaviyo account to start recovering missed revenue with a button Connect Klaviyo (not used), a box Your Data, Secure & in Your Control, two testimonial cards of the vendor and the buttons Back and Continue, the last one greyed out. The store name with its small icon in the bottom left corner of the menu is hidden, and so are the photos and names of the two people in the vendor testimonials at the bottom (third parties); the quotes themselves and the company logos stay.

The dialog Uninstall Attribuly? on the app page (Public app by Attribuly, Installed 17 November 2026) with the text that you will no longer be able to use the app, that data managed by the app, such as discounts, will be deleted, and that a request will be sent to the app developer within 48 hours to delete all personal customer information, a menu Reason for uninstalling (Select all that apply), a box Share feedback (0/250) and the buttons Cancel and a greyed out Uninstall; behind the dialog the app page shows Missing and Enforced values. The organization name and the store name with their icons in the left menu, and the small store icon in the bottom left corner, are hidden.
